ledger_entries_quantity_sign.name: ledger_entries_quantity_sign
ledger_entries_quantity_sign.value:
"ledger_entries"."reverses" is not null or "ledger_entries"."kind" = 'adjust'
        or ("ledger_entries"."kind" = 'in' and "ledger_entries"."quantity" > 0)
        or ("ledger_entries"."kind" = 'out' and "ledger_entries"."quantity" < 0)

scheduler_exceptions_hours.name: scheduler_exceptions_hours
scheduler_exceptions_hours.value: ("scheduler_exceptions"."start_time" is null and "scheduler_exceptions"."end_time" is null) or coalesce("scheduler_exceptions"."start_time" < "scheduler_exceptions"."end_time", false)
